changelog: BIM-Bot v2.8.0 — NEW: Navisworks → Power BI dashboards. Export the open federated model to a ready-to-open Power BI template (.pbit) with the interactive BIM-Bot 3D Viewer bound to every visual: click an element to filter the report, filter the data to isolate elements in 3D. A default dashboard (Model Overview + Clash Coordination: KPI cards, slicers, charts, clash list) or a custom one; dashboards are saved per project next to the NWF so they can be edited and re-exported. Re-exports are update-aware: when only the model data changed, the report file is left untouched so manual Power BI edits survive — press Refresh. Full model or selection/selection-set scope; live (refreshable) or static snapshot exports. New AI tools: navis_dashboard_catalog, _list, _get, _create, _update, _delete, _export.
